Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Zagreb, Croatia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES from 01.07.2013.
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Republic of Croatia are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.- Information for travel to the Republic of Croatia -
